_comment: Example staging document. It carries no credentials, no tenant hostnames
and no absolute local paths - only public, anonymously readable Microsoft
sample data. Copy it, point the entries at wherever the fixtures are
actually staged, and pass it to `python -m certification plan --staging`.
`hosts` becomes the safety gate's allowlist: a generated LOCATION that
resolves to any other host is refused before execution.
Blob paths are case-sensitive. A wrong-case directory fails with error
13807 (directory cannot be listed) rather than returning no rows, so keep
the casing exactly as the container reports it.
An `engine_local` entry is a path on the *engine host*, not on this
machine. Cells that read a file with no data source (C07, C11, C15) are
planned NOT_EXECUTABLE until one is supplied, because a client worktree
path handed to a server earns error 4860, not a certification result.
Newline-delimited JSON read through abs:// row framing - the shape the
live run proved (729 rows on both engines). Confirm the blob path
against the container before executing; an https TYPE = BLOB_STORAGE
source cannot read this, because that connector rejects the delimiter
